What we do

Tarmac and paving services in Belfast

From a single driveway to a full commercial yard, laid to falls on a base built to last.

Tarmac Driveways

Hot rolled asphalt laid and compacted to a clean even finish, edged so it holds its shape.

Block Paving

Traditional and contemporary blocks laid to falls with proper edge restraints, so nothing creeps.

Porcelain and Natural Stone

Porcelain, sandstone and riven slabs set out so the joints line through and the levels work.

Groundworks and Drainage

Excavation, sub base, channel drains and gullies. The part nobody sees decides how long it lasts.

Paths, Steps and Edging

Kerbs, steps, brick piers and edge courses that tie the drive into the rest of the property.

Commercial Surfacing

Car parks, yards and access roads surfaced and lined, worked around your opening hours.

Before and after

Real transformations

The first plays through from start to finish. Drag the handle on the second to compare.

Project 01

Rear yard rebuilt in charcoal block paving

The old surface came out and the yard was dug down and filled with stone, compacted in layers and screeded flat. Charcoal blocks went down in herringbone with a twin buff and charcoal border, and a diamond inlay set into the middle.

Full excavationCompacted sub baseHerringbone layingFeature inlay
During
Finished
Project 02

Front driveway surfaced in tarmac with a slabbed parking bay

The front was opened up and split in two: tarmac across the drive itself, and a slabbed bay alongside it to park off the kerb. Both were laid to fall away from the house, with the edges finished flush so there is no lip to catch.

Tarmac surfacingSlabbed parking bayFlush edge detailFalls away from the house

Why choose us

Built to last, not just to look right

Plenty of firms can lay a surface. The difference shows in what is underneath it a year later.

The base is the job

Dug out to depth, geotextile down, sub base compacted in layers. Almost every failed driveway is a failed base.

Drainage done properly

Falls set away from the house, channel drains and gullies where they are needed, so a new drive does not create a new problem.

One team, start to finish

The person who quotes the job is on the job. No handing you to a subcontractor you have never met.

Genuinely local

Based in Belfast and working across Northern Ireland, so we are close by if anything needs looking at.

Left clean every day

Spoil taken away as we go, edges swept and the road left as we found it.

Domestic and commercial

From a single household driveway to a car park or yard, handled by the same people.

About us

BTP Belfast Tarmac and Paving N.I Ltd

A Belfast based tarmac and paving contractor working across Northern Ireland. Driveways, patios, paths and commercial surfacing, taken on from the excavation through to the final edge course rather than passing pieces of it around.

Most of what decides whether a driveway is still flat in ten years happens before anything is laid: how deep it was dug, what went in, how well it was compacted and where the water goes. That is the part we will not rush.
